boot_rom.basis: The X-E4 ROM window read matches the X-S10 reference byte for byte; the ROM reference is registered in firmware.json.

boot_strap.basis: The ROM selects the card when bits 0x18 are clear. Both words are declared virtual inputs following X-T3; the physical X-E4 strap is unmeasured.

last_write_banks.basis: Virtual last-write words above the GPIO model used by the first-stage setup; physical behavior is unmeasured.
Virtual last-write page used by the first-stage setup; physical behavior is unmeasured.
Virtual setup window follows X-T3; it covers the X-E4 first refusal and physical behavior is unmeasured.
Virtual setup window follows X-T3 and excludes the modeled DSP page; physical behavior is unmeasured.

fixed_words.basis: Virtual DRAM training results follow X-T3; physical X-E4 values are unmeasured.

power_inputs.basis: Virtual cold boot reason follows the X-E4 flash-start handoff; the physical value is unmeasured.
